channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Assistant coach Kerry Sutherland’s cancer battle inspires ‘fight’ mentality for Hopkins
item.description: Basketball Across Minnesota: Royals boys assistant Sutherland won’t let cancer keep him from coaching.

item.title: Brian Dinkelman named manager of St. Paul Saints
item.description: Dinkelman has managed in the organization for seven seasons and replaces Toby Gardenhire, who is on the Twins major league staff.

item.title: Ramstad: The response to fraud in Minnesota is now overkill
item.description: Minnesotans are being terrorized by ICE. As funding delays ruin caregiving businesses and charities, those who depend on human services worry about losing them.

item.title: Minnesota’s biggest companies starting to feel heat from ICE surge
item.description: From Target to General Mills and Caribou Coffee, Minnesota’s largest employers are feeling pressure amid a surge of immigration officers in the state following the killing of Renee Good.

item.title: ICE arrested dozens of refugees in Minnesota and sent them to Texas, lawyers say
item.description: The refugees, many of them from Somalia, had passed security screenings before coming to the United States. The Trump administration has vowed to “re-examine thousands of refugee cases.”

item.title: Fatal ICE shooting shakes up races for U.S. Senate, governor
item.description: Democrats are battling over past immigration votes in Minnesota’s open U.S. Senate seat, while Republicans in the party’s crowded field for governor attempt to lay the blame for the shooting on Democratic politicians.

item.title: Mass resignation at Minnesota U.S. Attorney’s Office stems from Renee Good shooting, investigation
item.description: At least six attorneys have left the U.S. Attorney’s Office, including Joe Thompson, who took the lead in prosecuting fraud in state government programs.

item.title: MN lawmaker wants to outlaw federal agents’ face coverings statewide. St. Paul mulls its own rules.
item.description: The bill’s author acknowledges the measure will likely not make federal agents show their faces, but hopes local police take note of the problems masks cause.

item.title: With ICE surge spreading across state, rumors and anxiety grow in greater Minnesota
item.description: Reports of federal agents conducting arrests has some residents on edge in cities and rural communities.

item.title: The latest: Renee Good family hires lawyer amid fatal shooting probe
item.description: Law firm that represented George Floyd’s family has been hired by Renee Good’s family. A federal judge declined to immediately rule on the ICE surge in Minnesota.
